app.title: SiiMatchMind AI — football match analysis and prediction
lang.label: Language
note.demo: Demo data: fictional teams and computer-generated results
home.title: Matches
home.hint: Tap any match to see its analysis and prediction.
analyze.title: Match analysis
an.matrix_cap: Rows: goals of {home} • Columns: goals of {away} • Values are percentages (the outlined score is the most likely).
an.form_cap: W = win, D = draw, L = loss (most recent first).
an.h2h_none: No previous meetings in the data.
an.h2h_cap: Head-to-head results are shown for context; the probability model does not use them.
an.availability_cap: Shown for information only; the model does not adjust probabilities for it.
reason.strength: {team}: attack {att} vs league average, defence {dfn} (higher is better).
reason.home_adv: Home advantage from league data: hosts average {mu_h} goals vs {mu_a} for visitors.
reason.home_form: {team} at home: {w} wins, {d} draws, {l} losses in the last {n} matches.
reason.away_form: {team} away: {w} wins, {d} draws, {l} losses in the last {n} matches.
conf.few_matches: Few previous matches for one of the teams ({n}).
conf.close_probs: Probabilities are very close, so the match is open to several outcomes.
conf.none: No extra notes. Confidence is relative, not a guarantee.
missing.no_injury_model: The model does not account for injuries, line-ups or suspensions.
missing.no_stats: Possession, shots and corners statistics are not available in the current data source.
missing.few_h2h: There are few head-to-head matches, so they carry little information.
missing.no_availability: No injury or line-up information is available for this match.
disclaimer: The prediction is a statistical estimate, not a guarantee of the result.
disclaimer.demo: The data shown is demo data.
stat.title: Match statistics (averages)
stat.cap: Averages over the matches that have statistics.
stat.none: Possession, shots and corners statistics are not available in the current data source.
teams.title: Teams
team.strength: Attack strength {att} • Defence strength {def} (1.00 = league average; higher is better)
saved.title: Saved
saved.fav_empty: Nothing saved yet. Open an analysis and tap “Save to favourites”.
saved.cap_local: These lists are stored on this device only. Sign in to keep them on the server.
saved.cap_server: These lists are stored in your account on the server.
acct.title: Account
acct.intro: Sign in to keep your favourites and history across devices.
acct.needs_server: Accounts need the server. Run the server version of the app to use them.
q.title: Prediction quality
q.unavailable: Not enough matches for a back-test yet.
q.note_demo: Results on demo data generated by computer: they only check that the prediction pipeline is sound, and say nothing about accuracy on real matches.
q.note_real: Back-test on real matches the model had not seen.
q.tested: Test on matches the model had not seen ({n} matches)
q.explain: The baseline repeats the historical win/draw/loss rates. Guessing equally (⅓ each) gives Brier = {u}.
q.better: The model beats the baseline on Brier.
q.notbetter: The model did not beat the baseline on Brier.
q.calib_cap: The closer the last two columns, the more honest the probabilities. Average gap: {e}.
err.load: Could not load the data. Make sure the server is running.

err.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
err.admin_disabled: The admin panel is disabled on this server.
admin.title: Admin dashboard
admin.note: Live quality compares predictions logged before kick-off with real results.
league.label: League
err.different_leagues: These teams are in different leagues.
note.archive: {league} • season {season} — archive: the free plan has no current fixtures
acct.delete_prompt: Enter your password to permanently delete your account:
err.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a minute.
stand.title: League table
stand.note: Computed from the stored results: points, then goal difference, then goals scored. It may differ from the official table where other tie-breakers apply.
theme.label: Theme
press.title: Press predictions
press.note: Headlines and links from sports newspapers. ⭐ marks a preview or prediction. Articles belong to their publishers; tapping a headline opens the source.
about.title: About us
about.p1: I'm Berra, the creator of this app. The idea started from my passion for football and my love of numbers. I wanted one place where I could find match analysis and predictions, clear and simple.
about.p2: I hope you find here what entertains and helps you before every match. If you have a remark or a suggestion, I'd be glad to hear it, because it's what makes the app better every day.
about.p3: Enjoy the analysis, and take care.
about.disc: The predictions and analyses in this app are for entertainment and information only. They are not betting or financial advice, and no one can guarantee a match result.
